import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class MCMF {
        static class Edge {
            int to, rev, capacity, cost;
            Edge(int to, int rev, int capacity, int cost) {
                this.to = to;
                this.rev = rev;
                this.capacity = capacity;
                this.cost = cost;
            }
        }

        List<Edge>[] graph;
        int[] dist;
        boolean[] inQue;
        int[] prevNode, prevEdge;

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        public MCMF(int n) {
            graph = new List[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            dist = new int[n];
            inQue = new boolean[n];
            prevNode = new int[n];
            prevEdge = new int[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int from, int to, int capacity, int cost) {
            graph[from].add(new Edge(to, graph[to].size(), capacity, cost));
            graph[to].add(new Edge(from, graph[from].size() - 1, 0, -cost));
        }

        int[] solve(int s, int t) {
            int flow = 0, cost = 0;
            int n = graph.length;
            while (true) {
                Arrays.fill(dist, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                Arrays.fill(prevNode, -1);
                Arrays.fill(inQue, false);
                dist[s] = 0;
                Queue<Integer> queue = new LinkedList<>();
                queue.offer(s);
                inQue[s] = true;
                while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
                    int u = queue.poll();
                    inQue[u] = false;
                    for (int i = 0; i < graph[u].size(); i++) {
                        Edge e = graph[u].get(i);
                        if (e.capacity > 0 && dist[u] + e.cost < dist[e.to]) {
                            dist[e.to] = dist[u] + e.cost;
                            prevNode[e.to] = u;
                            prevEdge[e.to] = i;
                            if (!inQue[e.to]) {
                                inQue[e.to] = true;
                                queue.offer(e.to);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (dist[t] == Integer.MAX_VALUE) break;
                int df = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                for (int u = t; u != s; u = prevNode[u]) {
                    int v = prevNode[u], i = prevEdge[u];
                    df = Math.min(df, graph[v].get(i).capacity);
                }
                for (int u = t; u != s; u = prevNode[u]) {
                    int v = prevNode[u], i = prevEdge[u];
                    graph[v].get(i).capacity -= df;
                    int rev = graph[v].get(i).rev;
                    graph[u].get(rev).capacity += df;
                }
                flow += df;
                cost += df * dist[t];
            }
            return new int[]{flow, cost};
        }
    }

    static final int NN = 6000;
    static final int INF = 100000000;

    static List<Integer>[] v = new ArrayList[NN];
    static List<Integer>[] rev = new ArrayList[NN];
    static List<Integer>[] cost = new ArrayList[NN];
    static List<Integer>[] cap = new ArrayList[NN];

    static int[] dist = new int[NN];
    static boolean[] vis = new boolean[NN];
    static int[] prex = new int[NN], prei = new int[NN];

    static int s = NN - 1;
    static int t = NN - 2;

    static void addEdge(int x, int y, int c, int w) {
        rev[x].add(v[y].size());
        rev[y].add(v[x].size());
        v[x].add(y);
        v[y].add(x);
        cost[x].add(w);
        cost[y].add(-w);
        cap[x].add(c);
        cap[y].add(0);
    }

    static void spfa(int s) {
        Arrays.fill(dist, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        Arrays.fill(vis, false);
        prex[s] = -1;
        dist[s] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        vis[s] = true;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int x = q.poll();
            vis[x] = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < v[x].size(); i++) {
                int y = v[x].get(i);
                int cc = dist[x] + cost[x].get(i);
                if (dist[y] > cc && cap[x].get(i) > 0) {
                    dist[y] = cc;
                    prex[y] = x;
                    prei[y] = i;
                    if (!vis[y]) {
                        vis[y] = true;
                        q.offer(y);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int tot = 0;

    static int dfs(int x, int flow) {
        if (prex[x] == -1) return flow;
        int y = x;
        x = prex[y];
        int i = prei[y];
        int j = rev[x].get(i);
        int f = dfs(x, Math.min(flow, cap[x].get(i)));
        cap[x].set(i, cap[x].get(i) - f);
        cap[y].set(j, cap[y].get(j) + f);
        return f;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        for (int i = 0; i < NN; i++) {
            v[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            rev[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            cost[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            cap[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        int get = (x, time) -> time * 52 - 52 + x;

        int s_node = s;
        int t_node = t;
        int kk = k;

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            addEdge(s_node, get(x, 1), 1, 0);
        }

        k = kk;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            int y = sc.nextInt();

            for (int j = 1; j < 100; j++) {
                for (int j1 = 1; j1 <= k; j1++) {
                    addEdge(get(x, j), get(y, j + 1), 1, d * (j1 + j1 - 1));
                }
            }
            // swap x, y
            int temp = x; x = y; y = temp;
            for (int j = 1; j < 100; j++) {
                for (int j1 = 1; j1 <= k; j1++) {
                    addEdge(get(x, j), get(y, j + 1), 1, d * (j1 + j1 - 1));
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < 100; i++) {
            for (int j1 = 1; j1 <= n; j1++) {
                addEdge(get(j1, i), get(j1, i + 1), INF, 0);
            }
            addEdge(get(1, i), t_node, INF, c * (i - 1));
        }

        int[] result = new MCMF().solve(s_node, t_node);
        System.out.println(result[1]);
    }
}
